v.t: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
